welcome_page_usage_content0.message: There are four ways to use FastStream

welcome_page_usage_content1.message: You can go to a website with a video stream, and turn FastStream on by clicking on the icon. Play the stream and the client will be auto-replaced with FastStream

welcome_page_usage_content2.message: You can go to a new tab, and press the extension icon to go to the player.

welcome_page_usage_content3.message: If you have the option enabled, go to an mp4/mpd/m3u8 URL and the player will play it.

welcome_page_usage_content4.message: Keep the player open in a new tab and it will collect sources as you browse elsewhere.

welcome_page_usage_end.message: Thank you for installing FastStream! Please let us know if you have any issues or suggestions.

welcome_page_keybinds_content11.message: - Set speed to 1x, 2x, 2.5x, 3x, 3.5x, 4x, 5x, 8x or 16x - press the same key again to revert

perms_page_about_header.message: About the Permissions Required by FastStream

perms_page_about_content0.message: In order for the extension to function, it needs to be able to have certain permissions. These permissions are only used for basic functionality.

perms_page_about_content1.message: FastStream does not collect any data from you and does not track you. It has no server of its own. It only connects to the sites whose videos you play, to OpenSubtitles when you search for subtitles, and to GitHub to check for updates.

perms_page_about_content2.message: Don't trust me? FastStream has its source available on

perms_page_about_content3.message: You can look through the code yourself, or manually install your very own custom build by following the instructions.

perms_page_breakdown_content0.message: Here is a breakdown of the permissions FastStream requires, and why it needs them.

perms_page_breakdown_content1.message: Note: The linked examples may refer to an older version of the code, but the gist should be the same overall. The list is not exhaustive; items are ordered by importance.

perms_page_breakdown_perm1h.message: Be able to access and modify all websites

perms_page_breakdown_perm1d.message: FastStream needs to be able to access all websites so that it can inject the player into the website directly. It injects a content script into websites you visit in order to:

perms_page_breakdown_perm1r1.message: Identify the largest visible video element to replace with the player.

perms_page_breakdown_perm1r2.message: Enable fullscreen permissions when the player is injected into a frame.

perms_page_breakdown_perm1r3.message: Scrape subtitle <track> elements from the page.

perms_page_breakdown_perm2d.message: FastStream needs to be able to intercept HTTP requests to video sources in order to:

perms_page_breakdown_perm3d.message: FastStream needs to be able to modify HTTP headers of select requests in order to:

perms_page_breakdown_perm4d.message: FastStream needs to be able to store data in your browser so that it can remember your settings.

perms_page_breakdown_perm5d.message: FastStream needs to be able to send messages between players and content scripts in each tab.

perms_page_breakdown_perm5r1.message: Sending sources to players from the background script.

perms_page_breakdown_perm6h.message: Exchange messages with programs other than Firefox

perms_page_breakdown_perm6d.message: Only for mpv: when a video goes to mpv, FastStream hands it to the FastStream mpv host on your own computer, which opens it in mpv. Without that host, this permission is never used.

perms_page_breakdown_perm7d.message: FastStream saves files to your downloads when you ask it to: a video, a screenshot, a subtitle file or your exported settings.

perms_page_breakdown_perm8d.message: Only to see which Firefox container a tab is in, so that a download started in a container tab happens in that same container. FastStream never reads, changes or sends your cookies.

options_autourl_body.message: Will automatically enable the extension upon visiting these URLs and disable upon leaving. One URL per line, pages starting with that URL will also match (https:// and www. can be left out: crunchyroll.com). For regex, prepend with a tilde (~). One regex per line. To exclude sites, prepend with an exclamation mark (!). To leave a whole site alone - no auto-enable, and its stream links not opened in the player - prepend its domain with a minus sign (-).

options_pattern_body.message: These patterns are used to detect custom video sources on webpages. They are applied in order, and the first match is used. For advanced users only.

options_mpv_toggle.message: Open detected streams in mpv (external player)

options_mpv_body.message: When MPV mode is on, the toolbar button toggles between Off, On (built-in player) and MPV. On allowlisted sites, detected streams open directly in mpv on your computer instead of the browser player. Requires mpv and the FastStream mpv host on your computer: on Windows, the one-click setup (first link below) installs both; the manual setup (second link) is for developers and other systems.

options_mpv_allowlist_hint.message: Sites on this list open detected streams in mpv. One URL per line; pages starting with that URL also match (https:// and www. can be left out: crunchyroll.com @anime). Use ~ for regex and ! to exclude. Untagged sites default to Movie for mpv's shader selection -- add @anime at the end of a line for anime sites. @movie is also accepted, if you want it written out. The player's mpv button can override this per video.

player_vpn_allow_tooltip.message: This page gets its video through Firefox VPN, which leaves FastStream's requests out, and the site may refuse them. Click to allow FastStream to use the same connection (once, on FastStream's permissions page).

perms_page_breakdown_perm9d.message: Only used with Firefox VPN. Firefox lists it as control of the browser's proxy settings, but FastStream changes no setting: it sends its own requests for a video the same way the page's own requests went, through the VPN. Without it, a site that ties its video to the VPN's address refuses FastStream. The player asks for it the first time it is needed.
